a.lede: "It makes America weaker to knock him out," the Anduril CEO said about ousted Nvidia leader Jensen Huang.
a.title: Palmer Luckey thinks China is ‘thrilled to have Jensen out,’ so he wants the ousted Nvidia CEO reinstated

b.lede: President Trump has called for Jensen Huang to return as Nvidia CEO, but a new report says the board is not considering the move.
b.title: Trump calls for Jensen Huang reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
